validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and well-documented. This is Package 7 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3), the laying of the 56-inch east-west gas pipelines '3' and '4' from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8. Confirmed by MEED (which explicitly names EWPS-6, the 340 km figure, '56-inch' and 'east-west'), corroborated independently by Oil & Gas News (ognnews) and by Larsen & Toubro's Sept-2025 completion announcement of a 120 km 56-inch MGS Package 8 section (pipeline-journal.net / oilandgasmiddleeast / zawya). >=2 independent origins -> high. NOT a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct. It is a 56-inch main east-west gas transmission trunk (commodity Gas), correctly PipelineType=transmission. DUPLICATE (checked against roster): P6725 is 'EWPS-6-EWPS-8 "3"' with identical 170 km/56 in specs. These are NOT a double-count: the source describes 'east-west gas pipelines THREE and FOUR' as two distinct parallel lines (loops 3 and 4) along the same corridor. P6725=line 3, P6726=line 4 -> two separate physical pipes. Keep both. The same 3/4 pairing runs across the whole cluster (P6717/18, P6719/20, P6721/22, P6723/24, P6727/28). ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco confirmed (MEED); Fuel=Gas confirmed. Location [ref] was blank -> filled with MEED (see fills). Province not populated (corridor is in the Eastern Province heading west, but pump-station endpoints not province-confirmed by a citable source). SPEC: diameter 56 in = high (MEED/OGN/L&T all say 56-inch). Length 170 km = high but note the derivation: MEED states the EWPS-6->EWPS-8 span is 340 km for BOTH lines 3 and 4 combined; GEM correctly splits this into 170 km per parallel line (340/2). StartYear1=2028 consistent with the documented Q4-2028 project completion.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: MGS-3 EPC construction commenced Q2-2024 (on-site activities from Dec-2024) with documented completion Q4-2028. Most recent independent evidence: Larsen & Toubro announced Sept-2025 the completion of a 120 km 56-inch MGS Phase-3 pipeline section (Package 8) - construction is actively progressing, not stalled. As of mid-2026 the project is still years from its 2028 in-service target, so 'construction' remains correct. Newer than the sheet's 2025-08 LastUpdated. No evidence of commissioning/operation. Verdict=confirm.
